items.solution: True multilingual architecture with independent SEO per language

items.title: Invisible in luxury search

solution.label: THE SOLUTION
solution.title: What a Umania luxury real estate website includes

items.title: Editorial design with photo and video at the centre
items.description: Cinematic walkthroughs, high-resolution galleries, and serif typography that signals exclusivity before the first enquiry.

items.title: True multilingual with SEO per language
items.description: Spanish, English and key markets with independent URLs, metadata and hreflang. Each language competes in its market — not a surface-level translation.

items.title: Conversion architecture for qualified leads
items.description: Visible forms, contextual WhatsApp, private viewing scheduling, and an AI agent that qualifies budget and area before handoff to your team.

items.title: Luxury SEO by zones and typologies
items.description: Pages optimised for Son Vida, Port d'Andratx, Deià, rustic estates, waterfront and off-market properties with international buyer intent.

items.title: Speed, trust and a sense of exclusivity
items.description: Optimised Core Web Vitals, progressive media loading, and a fluid experience that reinforces premium brand perception from the first second.

walkthrough.label: EXPERIENCE
walkthrough.title: Walkthrough of a luxury villa
walkthrough.description: This is how an exclusive property feels on screen: unhurried pace, natural light, and spaces that breathe — the same editorial logic we apply to your portfolio.

audience.label: FOR WHOM
audience.title: International buyers who demand coherence
audience.ruleTitle: Your website is the first private viewing
audience.ruleDescription: For a luxury villa portfolio, digital presence must inspire the same trust as an in-person visit. Investing in an editorial website is not a marketing expense — it is the infrastructure that attracts the right buyer before they contact a competitor.

items.name: Spain HNWI
items.insight: They value discretion, visual quality, and immediate response. Clear forms and direct agent contact are essential.

items.name: UK + Northern Europe
items.insight: They expect flawless English, local SEO by area, and an experience comparable to top London or Geneva agencies.

items.name: Scandinavia + DACH
items.insight: They prioritise clarity, performance, and technical trust. True multilingual and speed are decisive differentiators.

items.question: Do you build multilingual luxury real estate websites?
items.answer: Yes. We develop true multilingual architectures — not translation plugins — with independent URLs, metadata, and SEO per language to reach buyers in Spain, the UK, Northern Europe, and other key markets.

items.question: Does SEO work per language?
items.answer: Each language has its own strategy: keywords, canonical, hreflang, and market-adapted content. We rank for Mallorca zones, property types, and international search intent.

items.question: Do you integrate CRM or real estate software?
items.answer: We integrate forms with your CRM, private portals, or portfolio management tools. We define the flow in the briefing: web capture, qualification, and handoff to your sales team.

items.question: How do you capture international buyers?
items.answer: We combine multilingual SEO, editorial content by area, contextual WhatsApp, a qualifying AI agent, and visible CTAs at every stage. The goal is to filter browsers and accelerate contacts with real budget.

items.question: Do you have cases with results or metrics?
items.answer: We work with premium agencies and developers in Mallorca. On the discovery call we share sector references, conversion metrics, and the editorial approach applied to portfolios similar to yours.
